notes.title: Info screen added with new patch version!
notes.content:
Hi all and thanks again for downloading Cubiques.

This version includes a new info button and adjustments to the main menu screen. The info button now pulls an info screen with few keyboard strokes that are useful during gameplay.

Also ability to control button selection through the keyboard on main screen, settings, reset game, and info screens.

Thanks again.

Indie Game Developer
Dilmer Valecillos

notes.title: Cubiques New patch is available now!
notes.content:
First of all I want to thank everyone for providing feedback with the initial game version and I am providing you with an overview of what was added in this new patch.

1- Added WASD movement controls. I know this is more comfortable for some of you and arrow keys are also still available for moving red.

2- Pressing escape on your keyboard now allows you to exit out of the game if you are on the landing main game menu.

3- Pressing escape from level selector or game play now allows you to go back to the previous screen.

Again thanks for your feedback and I will be adding more improvements this weekend.

Indie Game Developer
Dilmer Valecillos
